Struct DepthStencilStateDesc

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura

The description of the depth-stencil state, which controls how depth testing and stencil testing are performed during rendering.

Constructors

DepthStencilStateDesc()

Initializes a new instance of the DepthStencilStateDesc struct with default settings. Both depth and stencil testing are disabled; masks are set to full (0xFF); front/back faces use default operations (Keep, except pass op increments).

public DepthStencilStateDesc()

DepthStencilStateDesc(bool, bool, StencilComparisonFunc)

Initializes a new instance of the DepthStencilStateDesc struct, specifying whether depth and stencil testing are enabled, and the depth comparison function. All other properties retain default values (e.g., full read/write masks, keep operations).

public DepthStencilStateDesc(bool depth, bool stencil, StencilComparisonFunc depthFunction = StencilComparisonFunc.Less)

Parameters

depth bool

Whether to enable depth testing.

stencil bool

Whether to enable stencil testing.

depthFunction StencilComparisonFunc

The comparison function used for depth testing (ignored if depth is false). Defaults to Less.

DepthStencilStateDesc(bool, bool, StencilComparisonFunc, StencilOperation, StencilOperation, byte, byte, StencilOperation)

Initializes a new instance of the DepthStencilStateDesc struct with full control over depth/stencil behavior, including per-face operations and masks.

public DepthStencilStateDesc(bool depth, bool stencil, StencilComparisonFunc depthFunction, StencilOperation stencilPassOp, StencilOperation stencilFailOp = StencilOperation.Keep, byte stencilReadMask = 255, byte stencilWriteMask = 255, StencilOperation stencilDepthFailOp = StencilOperation.Keep)

Parameters

depth bool

Whether to enable depth testing.

stencil bool

Whether to enable stencil testing.

depthFunction StencilComparisonFunc

The comparison function used for depth testing (ignored if depth is false).

stencilPassOp StencilOperation

The operation applied on front/back faces when both stencil and depth tests pass.

stencilFailOp StencilOperation

The operation applied on front/back faces when the stencil test fails. (Note: This applies to both faces; for separate per-face control, use FrontFaceStencilFailOp and BackFaceStencilFailOp.)

stencilReadMask byte

The mask applied during stencil reads. Default is 0xFF.

stencilWriteMask byte

The mask applied during stencil writes. Default is 0xFF.

stencilDepthFailOp StencilOperation

The operation applied on front/back faces when stencil passes but depth fails.

DepthEnabled

Enables or disables depth testing. When disabled, depth values are not compared, and depth buffer updates are ignored.

public bool DepthEnabled

Field Value

bool

DepthFunction

Specifies the comparison function used to evaluate depth values during depth testing. Common values include Less, Equal, and Greater. Only applies when DepthEnabled is true.

public StencilComparisonFunc DepthFunction

Field Value

StencilComparisonFunc

DepthWriteEnable

Controls whether depth values are written to the depth buffer. Only effective when DepthEnabled is true. Set to false for depth testing without writing (e.g., shadow mapping occlusion queries).

public bool DepthWriteEnable

Properties

StencilReadMask

Specifies the mask applied to stencil values during read operations (e.g., comparison). A value of 0xFF (default) means all bits are considered; 0x00 disables stencil tests entirely.

public byte StencilReadMask { get; set; }

Property Value

byte

StencilWriteMask

Specifies the mask applied to stencil values during write operations. Only bits set in this mask are updated when a stencil operation succeeds. A value of 0xFF (default) writes all bits; 0x00 prevents any write.

public byte StencilWriteMask { get; set; }

Property Value

byte
